claim: The pruning likelihood computes the correct marginal character likelihood.
evidence: tests/test_likelihood_oracle.py: 1200 random tiny cases agree with independent enumeration within 1e-9
counterevidence: none; disagreement would fail the gate

claim: The scale move's Jacobian is correct and necessary.
evidence: tests/test_mcmc_exact.py: Gamma target recovered with correct mean/variance; Jacobian-omitted negative control is detectably biased

claim: Missing and absent produce distinct likelihoods and the ascertainment correction matches the selection process.
evidence: tests/test_ascertainment.py: L(missing) > L(absent); analytic p(variable) matches simulated fraction within 0.005

claim: Interrupted chains resume with exact CPU state and no duplicated draws.
evidence: tests/test_recovery.py: resumed run bit-identical to uninterrupted run; corrupt checkpoint rejected

claim: The inferred chronology is identifiable only through calibration.
evidence: runs/sensitivity/sensitivity.json: root age shifts under half/no-calibration and tree-only; stable to tree-prior and ascertainment
counterevidence: a family with strong independent calibrations could yield a narrow identifiable date (Ch.13)

claim: The tree model reproduces pairwise cognate sharing but not the missingness pattern.
evidence: ppc on runs/smoke/dated: sharing bayesian_p approx 0.18; missingness p approx 0
counterevidence: missingness p=0 is a generative-check limitation, not a likelihood error

claim: Short runs of large trees do not converge and are not presented as posteriors.
evidence: diagnose on runs/smoke/dated: split-Rhat 1.1-2.8, ESS in tens, reported converged=false
counterevidence: none; this is a reported non-result

claim: Known-truth root-age credible intervals are roughly calibrated.
evidence: runs/recovery pilot: 90% CI coverage 0.8 on 5 datasets; full 200-dataset study pending
counterevidence: pilot is small; coverage below 0.9 in the full study would indicate over-confidence

claim: A latent homeland is reported as a posterior cloud, never a single pin when support is broad.
evidence: ui map view renders inferred locations as a density; exporter tags observation kinds; docs/screenshots/workbench.png
counterevidence: a removal-stable concentrated posterior could warrant a point claim (Ch.13)
